targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name, last_processed_ingested_at, extract(epoch from (now() - last_processed_ingested_at)) AS lag_seconds FROM control.watermarks ORDER BY lag_seconds DESC

SELECT 'customers' AS domain, count(*) FROM silver.error_customers WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'products', count(*) FROM silver.error_products WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_orders', count(*) FROM silver.error_sales_orders WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'payments', count(*) FROM silver.error_payments WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'inventory_changes', count(*) FROM silver.error_inventory_changes WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes' UNION ALL SELECT 'truck_positions', count(*) FROM silver.error_truck_positions WHERE rejected_at > now() - interval '15 minutes'
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ingested_at) AS time, count(*) AS orders FROM iot.sales_order_events WHERE ingested_at > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
